label: Town of Bridport
header:
# Town of Bridport municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 4; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Bridport official website, Contacts page: lists five Selectboard members: Tim Howlett (Chair), Drexel Wheeler, Stephanie Pope, Robert Sunderland, and David Bronson.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): publishes no Bridport roster ('Contact the Town Clerk'); the roster recorded here is from the town's official website.
Town of Bridport charter, Title 24 Appendix V.S.A. chapter 107A (2015 No. M-16): section 3 provides that the Town Clerk is appointed by the Selectboard.
Town of Bridport official website, Contacts page: names Julie Howlett as Town Clerk.
Town of Bridport charter, Title 24 Appendix V.S.A. chapter 107A (2015 No. M-16): section 3 provides that the Town Treasurer is appointed by the Selectboard.

Town of Bridport official website, Contacts page: names Luella Gipson as Town Treasurer. The Secretary of State's January 2026 Guide still names Kathleen Shimel; the town's current page governs, and the change is an appointment change under the charter.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Kathleen Shimel as Treasurer of Bridport (superseded by the town's current Contacts page).

Town of Bridport official website: the 2026 Town Meeting Warning warned election of a Moderator (one-year term), and the town's draft minutes of the March 2026 annual meeting record Tim Howlett elected Moderator. The minutes are posted in draft form; the election is recorded from them with that disclosure.

Town of Bridport official website: the town's draft minutes of the March 2026 annual meeting record Vicki Major elected Lister (three-year term); the minutes are posted in draft form. The holders of the other two lister seats are published in no official source and are left unfilled.

Town of Bridport official website: the 2026 Town Meeting Warning warned election of three Auditors (three-, two-, and one-year terms), and the town's draft minutes of the March 2026 annual meeting record 'No one was elected' for all three seats. The post is created structure only; all three seats are vacant.

Town of Bridport official website: the town's draft minutes of the March 2026 annual meeting record Richard Shimel elected First Constable (one-year term); the minutes are posted in draft form. He is a distinct person from former Town Treasurer Kathleen Shimel.
Town of Bridport official website: the town's draft minutes of the March 2026 annual meeting record Dusty Huestis elected Second Constable (one-year term); the minutes are posted in draft form.
Town of Bridport official website, Cemetery Commission page: the commission is composed of five members.

Town of Bridport official website: the town's draft minutes of the March 2026 annual meeting record David Basque elected Cemetery Commissioner (five-year term); the minutes are posted in draft form. The holders of the other four seats are published in no official source and are left unfilled.

17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a grand juror at annual town meeting. Structure only: no official source publishes the current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.

17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a town agent at annual town meeting. Structure only: no official source publishes the current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Bridport justices of the peace: Michael Bordeleau, Joan Huestis, Judd Markowski, Chris Goodrich, Philip Wagner, Steve Huestis, and Heather Hodsden.

jp_election.name: Town of Bridport Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Bridport justices of the peace for the 2025-2026 term; they are the winners of the November 5, 2024 election for the office. The listing publishes no vote totals and no party designations for justices of the peace.
